about: Catalogue of the real games with an oddity the engine once got wrong (issue #546, B3 of the testing strategy #540). The games are the recordings of tests/recordings (not copied); this file says what is odd about each, from which incident, and the probe that keeps the oddity in the fixture. Read tests/fixtures/weird_games/README.md.

games.match: Recoletas Zamora - Mipelletymas B.F. León (LF Challenge 2026/27)

oddities.what: FEB answers nothing (a real 404) for a few polls in the middle of the match: the app must not update, nor repeat what it said (7 polls of 10 s; how many fall in the gap depends on the cadence)
the play-by-play goes about a minute behind the scoreboard (55 s at worst: no logged event for that long is not normal in a game; the other games stay under 40 s): the rules of recent actions wait
annotation errors of the feed (a rebound credited to a player of the other team, 10 flagged): the possession tracker marks them

games.match: Cultural y Deportiva Leonesa - Melilla Ciudad del Deporte (2.ª FEB)
games.regression_only: the game of the 0.4.2 feedback (a streak across the 2nd quarter, the 2nd foul of A. Reyes); it has no structural oddity: it is here so the fixes of those alerts are checked against a whole real game

games.match: Class Basquet Sant Antoni - CE Bàsquet Llíria (LF Challenge)

oddities.what: 5 annotation errors of the feed flagged by the possession tracker (the average is about 2 per game); the teams of the report of #519 (a game FEB logged late) and the game where the +/- of the engine differs from the PDF (#594)

games.match: Oktícket Círculo Gijón - Caja Rural RDL (2.ª FEB)

oddities.what: 5 annotation errors flagged by the tracker; the game of the bug of the wrong package when switching match (its own package, polled by one engine)
a recording compressed to 2410 s for a 2400-second game: the clock of the feed and the clock of the recorder differ

games.match: C.B. Getafe - Cultural y Deportiva Leonesa (2.ª FEB, 24/10/2026)
games.source: The finished game downloaded from FEB (28/10/2026) and cut every 10 game-seconds as the app's replay does: real data, but the cadence is synthetic (no feed gaps and no lag of the log). Package rebuilt with tests/recordings/make_package.py.

oddities.what: an OVERTIME: the game lasts 2700 s, the 5th period has 5 minutes and its closing line is at 2700 s; every rule that thinks in 4 quarters (windows, fouls of the second half, the summary of the quarter) meets a period 5

games.source: The finished game downloaded from FEB (28/10/2026), cut every 10 game-seconds as the app's replay does: real data, synthetic cadence (no feed gaps, no log lag). Package rebuilt with make_package from the games of 2.ª FEB A before the match.
games.match: Cultural y Deportiva Leonesa - Alimerka Oviedo Baloncesto (Copa de España, 21/10/2026)

oddities.what: a CUP game between categories: Oviedo is 1ª FEB and has no season in the 2.ª FEB competition of the package, so the rival has no tables (no player baselines, no formation minimum); the game ends with the closing line 'Fin del Cuarto 4' at 40:00, read once as an overtime at 300x

games.source: The finished game downloaded from FEB (28/10/2026), cut every 10 game-seconds: real data, synthetic cadence, so the 40 s lag of the log of the report #564 is NOT reproduced (Zamora-León is the game with a real lag). Package rebuilt with make_package; the own team is Oses (the report does not say which side the staff followed).
games.match: Oses Construcción - Club Joventut Badalona (LF Challenge, 25/10/2026)

oddities.what: the game of the report of cold threes said right after a made one, of a timeout without a clear reason and of a run of -19 without origin: it has a cold-threes alert and 7 annotation errors
7 annotation errors of the feed flagged by the tracker

pending.what: a game whose table was corrected after the fact (header score different from the log's)
a 0-0 by points format, FBCYL with the remaining clock (#370), ids that change between seasons
